description: Reply to a request a task is waiting on, using the user's own words. For a question pass answer; for an approval pass decision approve or deny. An approval covers only the exact previewed batch, so retry it unchanged with alterlab_task_act. Only a question can be answered by this agent connection: a write approval must come from the user in their AlterLab dashboard or the AlterLab Connect extension, which approves through the user's own signed-in session (this call returns 403 approver_required otherwise). Find request ids in alterlab_task_status or alterlab_hands_pending.
name: alterlab_task_answer
title: Answer Task Request
